description: The response time a feature is designed for: under a second for inline suggestions, longer for reports, with progress feedback beyond about 10 seconds.
How long until the first streamed text appears. With streaming, it is the latency users actually feel.
Links from an answer to the passages it relies on, so users can check instead of trust.
Model output presented as a draft the user changes and confirms, keeping the human as the decision maker.
Signals from behavior (edits, retries, copies, escalations) that complement thumbs up or down.
Passing a conversation, with its context and what was tried, to a person when the assistant cannot help.
